title: 凹弧前缘与拔模前壁的圆角前输入

source_feature.meaning: Compare no attempt to bridge between given limits versus attempting a blend-like bridge using limits and underlying associations. patch_no remains a closed solid; patch_yes is an attempt, not a guaranteed smooth pass.

parts_geometry_immutable: Frozen low-confidence drafted_front_patch_seed input and pre-existing concave/rounded front walls; use current BRep hash, not older non-drafted group_b outline.
input.coincident_coplanar_face_merge_allowed: only if no contract topology is lost

semantic.candidate_side_roots: current two side-longitudinal upper edges in frozen world fingerprints
semantic.candidate_full_front_chain: side roots plus the five-segment front upper chain; documentary OCC7/10/16..20

world_edge_fingerprints.curve_matching: world position/shape and finite adjacency; analytic fit can be recovered from NURBS, never require same curve class or same topology index
world position/shape and finite adjacency; analytic fit can be recovered from NURBS, never require same curve class or same topology index

selection.expected_count_applies_to: geometric root chains/support intersections, not arbitrary backend edge segmentation

trigger_preconditions.condition: No/Yes start from identical side result; same radius, limits, support pairing; no replacing entire result by another fillet.

independent_oracles.assertion: No/Yes material and geometry identical outside frozen comparison ROI; changes limited to declared bridge region.
No mode has no new central transition but still has original closed front wall; do not label no as an open hole.

Yes geometry must join actual L/R limits with G0; publish quantitative join G1/G2 separately. If a G1 target is selected, all intended tangent interfaces <=0.1deg, with explicit exceptions for deliberate terminal C0.
independent_oracles.illustrative_smoothness_target: G1 demonstration, not specified by original PDF

independent_oracles.assertion: Without exact source limits/unders and selected topology, only illustrative No/Yes geometry can be checked; strict source-feature score remains source_contract_not_frozen.
independent_oracles.visual: Zoom two real bridge joints and show per-joint normal/curvature mismatch; build success alone is insufficient.

visual_difference_requirements: Keep stable number and original/input/actual-result three columns.
Show trigger region before/after, intended stop or overlap boundary, and true output edges; helper geometry is labeled.
Zoom two real bridge joints and show per-joint normal/curvature mismatch; build success alone is insufficient.

native_API_mapping.reason: The existing ordinary fillet entry does not itself encode this source option. Capability requires explicit native mapping or a separately labeled composition; missing adapter is not proof of kernel unsupported.

source_clarifications_required: Source only shows two operated results; initial edges, exact limit_topols, unders pairings, radius and requested continuity are not uniquely recovered.
Current L/R are demonstration boundaries from prior composition, not original PDF entity IDs.

scoring.source_feature_score_requires: trigger satisfied AND correct mode/selection supplied AND target-specific oracles passed AND common quality gates passed
